descriptionWave16: Wave 16 activates every remaining Calm Harbor flow except Support: (1) a standalone customer-owned Appointment detail route (appointment.detail) opened from upcoming/past rows — source-provided fields only, actions rendered exactly from allowedActions, ONE non-enumerating not-found for foreign/removed/unknown refs, cancelled/rescheduled readback states; (2) the COMPLETE booking flow in the accepted drawer from every supported entry (service Book, empty Appointments, Book again, Book with a credit, Reschedule): context → optional specialist (only when returned) → eligible date/slot selection with loading/empty/error → expiring SERVER slot hold (display label, never a local countdown; hold pending/held/expired/failed) → review with server display total, policy ack, repriced/conflict blocking, explicit 'Simulation — no charge will be made', and the authoritative Appointment-only / Appointment+Order confirmation; reschedules show current vs proposed and release the original visit only in the readback; plan-credit states ok/unavailable/exhausted/changed gate the flow verbatim; (3) package & membership purchase entry on the published offers while the sellable plan contract is open (data-plan-commerce, plan.purchase → the accepted SIMULATED checkout with source plan; sellable/unavailable/changed states; confirmation links to BOTH the created purchase and My plan); (4) the Calm Harbor least-data Profile (phone, email, approved preferences only; unchanged/dirty, invalid, saving, save-failed with confirmed values preserved, version conflict requiring profile.reload, session-lost, confirmed readback). Preserved runtime ALIASES (documented): order.reschedule/order.cancel/order.bookAgain → appointment.*, profile.saveContact (legacy generic panel). New dev selects: adet, plansell, offers, slots, credit.
descriptionWave15: Wave 15 extends the Calm Harbor portal with the customer commercial lifecycle under the accepted shell: Account (4th primary destination; entries available|unavailable per contract), Purchases list (backend-mapped customer statuses; filters only for returned kinds; cursor append), purchase detail (source-provided grouping only, separate totals/fulfillment/appointment/plan dimensions, capability-driven request flows for cancellation and returns with accepted-for-review readbacks and no refund claims), My plan (package vs recurring membership, server-provided balances only), the sellable Shop + persistent server cart + SIMULATED checkout behind the new retail-commerce-open capability (explicit 'Simulation — no charge will be made' treatment, 'Confirm order' — never 'Pay now', confirmation only from the authoritative readback: 'Order confirmed' / 'Booking confirmed' / 'Demo checkout completed'), and the booking confirmation bridge (paymentMode SIMULATED, blocking held-slot-expired / repriced review states, confirm result Appointment-only or Appointment+Order). New dev-toolbar selects: retail, acct, plan, cart, co, src, hold, bookres; state select adds unavailable.
description: Coverage map of routes, UI states, verticals (themes), feature flags and viewports. Wave 9 adds two non-weather verticals (Health, Beauty) on the new 'appointments' profile, with their own care hubs and SEO-landing content. Wave 10 replaces the fixture phone/OTP login with the Core OIDC redirect presentation: route auth.oidc at /login, module core-oidc-auth. Wave 11 ships the Beauty seo.landing as the Calm Harbor Spa release: seo-products-teaser (public PIM retail teaser), CMS media slots on hero/proof, and honest-navigation public CTAs (nav.services / nav.pricing / nav.products / auth.gotoSignin — no booking/payment/checkout command). Wave 13 adds the authenticated live-data states: a shared account-bootstrap gate (resolving-customer / customer-unavailable / customer-not-linked / customer-forbidden / session-expired — no private fixture data renders while unresolved/failed, TopNav renders gated), route lifecycle states on every private route root (loading/empty/error/unauthorized plus not-found/conflict where the route is entity-scoped), and an entity-scoped command lifecycle (state.commands['<action>:<entityId>'] = pending|failed|conflict; succeeded renders ONLY from the server readback; session-lost clears pending, suppresses success and opens the expired-session gate with the intended route preserved). Preview: dev-toolbar 'account' select (private routes), 'cmd' outcome select, extended 'state' select. Wave 14 ships the Calm Harbor Spa authenticated portal IA on the Beauty vertical: two capability variants of one portal (data-capability current-staging | target-appointments, data-booking closed | open, data-portal-profile spaStaging | spaTarget — deployment config, dev-toolbar preview). current-staging: Orders (neutral READ-ONLY Core Order rows — raw status unmapped, no dates/commands/navigation), Services & prices (one destination over the stable services+pricing routes), Shop (browse-only public PIM fields), account menu. target-appointments: Appointments as the authenticated default (next-appointment hero + upcoming/past; at-salon and at-your-place visit modes; long-label and missing-optional-field scenarios), '+ Book' and reschedule/cancel/book-again ONLY while booking is open; cancel is a full entity-scoped command (pending/failed/conflict/session-lost; success from readback only). Account bootstrap gains customer-account-ambiguous and organization-forbidden.

profiles.note: Portal profile is config-driven per vertical. Non-Beauty verticals map via fixtures.profileFor; Beauty (Calm Harbor) resolves from the capability config (state.capability -> spaStaging | spaTarget) and is intentionally absent from profileFor. Drives nav, primary action, cart, and which Calendar renders.

appointments.note: No weather triggers: these verticals set fixtures.themes[x].wt = null, which removes the Weather Trigger banner/panel and the weather feed item everywhere. Wave 14.1: Health only — Beauty moved to spaStaging/spaTarget.

spaStaging.booking: no booking command exists — no + Book anywhere
spaStaging.note: Wave 14. Account menu = identity + Support (honest unavailable notice) + light/dark + sign-out. Cannot select target appointment fixtures, Beauty Care/My routine navigation, membership state, cart/checkout or fixture support data.

spaTarget.calendar: appointments/booking-flow concern only — not a destination
spaTarget.booking: + Book and reschedule/cancel/book-again ONLY while data-booking=open; closed shows disabled controls + honest note
spaTarget.note: Wave 14. Target fixtures are capability-gated; loading/error/unauthorized gates render before any fixture. Same support-unavailable rule as spaStaging.

routes.note: Hero + quote card + service teasers; adapts per profile (onDemand vs stormOps copy).

Public SEO landing — ONE reusable section set (src/components/seo/SeoSections.js) serves all eight verticals; content = CMS slots in data/seo-fixtures.js keyed by vertical. Sections: seo-hero, seo-trust-strip, seo-services-grid, seo-how-it-works, seo-proof, seo-pricing, seo-service-area, seo-reviews, seo-faq (schema.org FAQPage microdata), seo-final-cta, seo-footer. loading/empty apply ONLY to dynamic-data sections (trust, pricing, service-area, reviews, faq, hero offer); hero/how/proof/footer are static. CTA lifecycle idle|pending|success|error on data-state of every seo-cta — preview via dev-toolbar 'cta' select. Head-level CMS fields (seoTitle, metaDescription, canonical, locality, primaryCta.destination) surfaced by the dev-only seo-meta-preview block (data-dev-toolbar — stripped on integration). Wave 11 (Calm Harbor / Beauty): seo-products-teaser sits between seo-pricing and seo-service-area — 3–4 cards from the repeated public PIM collection (pim.products[], data-product-code), public fields only, ONE action nav.products; states ready|loading|empty (seo-products-teaser-empty = honest empty catalog, no invented products). Hero + proof accept CMS media slots (cms.media.hero/proof — spec in MEDIA-SPEC.md). Beauty public CTAs are honest navigation ONLY: nav.services / nav.pricing (scroll to live sections), nav.products (public Shop route), auth.gotoSignin — no seo.cta.book/quote, payment, checkout, booking command or 'request sent' state; service cards route to pricing in this mode. book/quote verticals unchanged. Cover ready+empty at 1440/1180/768/390 in light and dark beauty modes. Wave 12: Beauty seo-pricing ready state renders the repeated LIVE public PIM collection pim.pricing[] (seo-pricing-row: code/name/displayPrice/optional interval|shortDescription, data-product-code; SPA_SERVICE + SPA_MEMBERSHIP only, never SPA_RETAIL; displayPrice verbatim — never computed); empty = honest no-published-items copy, no quote/booking/fallback price; public preview nav brand = cms.meta.brand (Calm Harbor Spa). Pricing evidence: previews/calm-harbor/pricing-{state}-{width}-{mode}.png — real viewport pixels, ready/loading/empty × desktop 1440 (1440×900, upscaled from a scaled-to-fit capture) + mobile 390 (true 390×540) × light/dark.

Core OIDC login (module core-oidc-auth) — authorization-code+PKCE redirect to the Core account service, returning to the same /login URL. checking-session = bootstrap on every load (incl. the callback return): discovery + session restore — non-interactive, no redirect claim, no controls, no session name. One primary action per interactive state: auth.oidcSignIn / auth.retrySession (unavailable = discovery/library init failure, no fallback login) / auth.signOut. Dynamic data = session status + one customer-safe display name (data-bind session.displayName). No password/token/Account-id in the browser. Public catalog nav stays before and after auth. Preview the states via the dev-toolbar 'oidc' select.
fixture phone step — kept for visual reference, reachable only via dev toolbar (auth.gotoSignin now routes to auth.oidc)
fixture 4-digit OTP step — kept for visual reference, reachable only via dev toolbar

Wave 14 (Beauty/Calm Harbor): capability current-staging renders SpaOrders — a neutral read-only Core Order list (type label/code, reference, raw UNMAPPED status, displayed total + currency; no date/time, specialist, location, tracking, invoice, detail navigation or reschedule/cancel/book-again); states ready(one|many via dev 'rows')/loading/empty/error/unauthorized. Capability target-appointments renders SpaAppointments — the appointment-first default (greeting, next-appointment hero, primary valid action, Upcoming/Past): scenarios salon | home | long | minimal | empty | no-history via dev 'appt' select, plus loading/error/unauthorized gates that never show a fixture. Other verticals keep the accepted Cabinet/StormHome.

variants.stormOps: weather-ops agenda: served, clear, storm-watch, snow-expected + event statuses scheduled/on-route/completed/skipped/delayed

routes.note: Wave 14 (Beauty): services + pricing render ONE 'Services & prices' destination (SpaCatalog) with an in-section tab; both stable route ids preserved (nav.go carries the route id). Public PIM lifecycle loading/ready/empty/error — prices verbatim, no availability claim; Book on cards only while data-booking=open, otherwise catalog navigation.
Wave 14 (Beauty): the pricing tab of SpaCatalog — SPA_SERVICE rows + 'Membership options' (public offers, never enrollment/balance). Other verticals keep the accepted Pricing page.

Wave 14 (Beauty): browse-only Shop (SpaShop) — code/name/short description/displayed price only; Browse-only chip; no Add to cart, inventory, availability, checkout or purchase success. Visually secondary to Appointments and Services & prices (muted last nav item; no rail placement). Other verticals keep the accepted Products page. Wave 15: under retail-commerce-open (data-retail) the SAME cards become sellable with SERVER sellability states (sellable | unavailable | out-of-stock | price-changed | variant-required), row-scoped add-to-bag commands and a bag indicator — copy never implies reservation.

Wave 15 (Beauty): SpaCheckout — SIMULATED checkout with states loading|ready|repriced|inventory-conflict|slot-expired|confirm-pending|confirm-failed|conflict|session-lost|unavailable|confirmed. Confirmation renders only from the authoritative readback. Other verticals keep the accepted generic checkout.

Opened via appointment.open (data-appointment-ref) from upcoming/past rows and the hero's View details. Actions render exactly from allowedActions (appointment.reschedule / appointment.cancel / appointment.bookAgain / appointment.openPurchase); while data-booking=closed they are honestly disabled with the support path. Dev select adet picks the scenario incl. unknown-ref.

Wave 16: on Beauty (Calm Harbor) this stable route renders the least-data SpaProfile instead — states loading|ready|error|unauthorized|unavailable, panel unchanged|dirty|invalid|saving|save-failed|conflict, session-lost via the global gate; only phone, email and the approved preferences render. Other verticals keep this accepted generic Profile.

Vertical care hub — content is vertical-specific (fixtures.careModules): HVAC equipment passport + diagnostics; Snow season/compliance log; Lawn season program + re-entry; Pool water quality; Roofing inspection report + project tracker; Pest station monitoring. Nav label comes from careModules[theme].navLabel. 'unauthorized' renders the entitlement-gate (plan doesn't include the hub). Wave 9: Health hub (kind healthCare) = upcoming appointment + care-plan milestones + follow-up tasks + secure documents (metadata only — NO clinical metrics/results rendered, by design) + provider card; Beauty hub (kind beautyCare) = appointment + session package + specialist preference + treatment/routine history + loyalty + routine products. Data contracts: care.selectUnit -> unit.id; care.download -> document.id; care.requestRetreat -> plan.planId + data-property-id + data-service-id; care.selectSpecialist -> specialist.id; care.completeTask -> task.id; care.contactProvider -> provider.id; care.openSecureDoc -> document.id. Stable entity ids: appt-*, prov-*, plan-*, pkg-*, spec-*, task-*, doc-*.

account-bootstrap (all private routes, w.note: data-state on the account-bootstrap module (data-intended-route = preserved route id). While state.account != ready the module replaces every private route body and the top-nav renders gated (brand + light/dark only). resolving-customer: non-interactive, no ids/claims. customer-unavailable: ui.retry data-id=account-bootstrap + auth.signOut, never a fixture fallback. customer-not-linked / customer-forbidden: non-enumerating, support.email + auth.signOut only. session-expired: auth.oidcSignIn returns to the preserved route; stale private data is never shown as current. Preview via the dev-toolbar 'account' select. Wave 14: customer-account-ambiguous (multiple Account matches — never enumerated, browser never picks; support.email + auth.signOut) and organization-forbidden (organization check failed — no org name/code/reason; support.email + auth.signOut).

command lifecycle (all mutable actions,.note: state.commands['<action>:<entityId>'] stamps data-state on the exact actionable entity — one row/card pending never disables unrelated entities; duplicate submission is blocked while pending. Covered commands: booking.confirm (booking.close closes without confirming), order.cancel:<orderId>, proposal.decide:<siteId> (approve/revision/decline; conflict blocks deciding until ui.retry reloads the latest version), cart.addItem:<name>, cart.mutate:<name> (inc/dec/remove), checkout.placeOrder:cart (failed = order NOT placed, cart intact; conflict = server re-priced cart, submit blocked until refresh; NO local success — the confirmation renders only after the readback navigates to orders), profile.saveContact:contact (validation → saving → confirmed readback / save failure), support.sendMessage:m<idx> (sending → sent on readback / failed with per-message support.retryMessage), care.requestRetreat:<planId>. Forced outcome via dev-toolbar 'cmd' select (state.cmdForce); session-lost clears pending, suppresses success and opens the expired-session gate.

core-oidc-auth (auth.oidc).note: data-state on the auth card. checking-session = initial bootstrap on every page load (incl. the return from /core/oauth2-callback.html): discovery + session restore from browser storage; non-interactive, claims no redirect, reveals no name — Codex resolves it to ready-signed-out / ready-signed-in / unavailable. Demo cycle: auth.oidcSignIn → redirecting (1.6s) → ready-signed-in (sets the fixture display name); auth.signOut → signing-out (1.4s) → ready-signed-out. In production 'redirecting' persists until the browser unloads for Core and 'unavailable' is set by Codex when discovery or the authorization library fails to initialize. Preview any state via the dev-toolbar 'oidc' select (visible on the route).

seo-cta (seo.landing).note: Fixed action ids: seo.cta.book / seo.cta.quote (primary, destination from cms.meta.primaryCta.destination), seo.cta.call, seo.cta.services (jump to grid), seo.service.select (grid card → booking/quote flow). Demo lifecycle: pending 900ms → success 800ms → booking drawer. 'error' is set by Codex on real command failure; preview any state via dev-toolbar 'cta' select (state.seoCtaForce). Wave 11: honest-navigation CTAs (nav.* / auth.gotoSignin) have NO lifecycle — data-state stays idle and ignores seoCtaForce.

seo-products-teaser (seo.landing).note: Follows the global dev-toolbar view switch (state select). ready = 3–4 seo-product-teaser-card from pim.products[] (data-product-code); empty = seo-products-teaser-empty (honest copy, section CTA hidden); loading = skeleton cards. Every interactive element fires nav.products only.

retreat-card (care, Pest Control).note: Visual states only — demo body of care.requestRetreat sets 'requesting' and stops; 'used' shows the guarantee-spent copy with a disabled button. Codex owns the real request, resolution and entitlement check. Preview via dev-toolbar 'retreat' select (visible on the pest care hub) or state.careRetreat.

follow-up-tasks (care, Health).note: care.completeTask toggles the per-task visual state (state.careTasksDone overrides the fixture done flag). Codex owns real task completion and sync.

specialist-picker (care, Beauty).note: care.selectSpecialist data-id = specialist.id (stable, e.g. spec-beauty-01); state.careSpecialist overrides the fixture preferredId. Codex owns persisting the preference.

spa capability (Beauty — Calm Harbor, wa.note: data-capability + data-booking + data-portal-profile on app-shell/top-nav/route roots. Target fixtures are capability-gated: not reachable while data-capability=current-staging. '+ Book' exists only in target+open; staging's only global CTA is honest navigation (Browse services). Preview via dev-toolbar 'spa'/'booking' selects.

states: unavailable (booking closed — disabled controls + honest note)
next-appointment commands (Beauty target.note: order.cancel:<appointmentId> runs the wave-13 command engine scoped to the exact card; reschedule/book/book-again enter the accepted booking drawer whose confirm carries the same lifecycle. Success is never local: the cancelled state renders only from the (demo) readback (state.spaCancelled). Force outcomes via the dev-toolbar 'cmd' select.

account-menu (spa shell, wave 14).note: Session identity (one customer-safe display name), Support, light/dark, secure sign-out. No profile editing or entitlement claims. Long-name wrap via dev-toolbar 'name' select. Wave 14.1: Support item ends at the support-unavailable notice.

support (Beauty — Calm Harbor, wave 14.1.note: No approved support destination and no opened customer support-thread source: support.open/support.email/support.call all end at the honest modal notice ('nothing was opened, sent or recorded'). The fixture support route, chat-panel, threads, tickets and agent state are unreachable through Calm Harbor navigation, and no success-like toast implies delivery.

orders.list: spa staging: ready one/many + unmapped raw status
spa staging: intentional mobile long-row composition (390 grid)
pricing: spa catalog tab + membership options (public offers)

notImplementedYet.note: All required routes are implemented. Remaining gaps are component-level states (e.g. per-field disabled) that Codex wires with real validation.
